entries.name: Theano
entries.definition: A Python library for defining and efficiently evaluating mathematical expressions on multi-dimensional arrays, used for deep learning research; its original development ended in 2017.

entries.name: Theatrical techniques
entries.definition: The methods of acting, voice, movement and staging used to prepare and perform theatre.

entries.name: Theory of change
entries.definition: A way of planning and evaluating social programmes by mapping how activities are expected to lead to outcomes and long-term change.

entries.name: Therapeutic interventions
entries.definition: Planned treatments or activities, such as counselling, exercise or medication management, that a clinician applies to improve a client's health or functioning.

entries.name: Thin film coating
entries.definition: Depositing a very thin layer of material onto a surface by methods such as sputtering, evaporation or chemical vapour deposition.

entries.name: Third party risk management
entries.definition: Identifying, assessing and controlling the risks that arise from an organisation's use of outside suppliers, vendors and service providers.

entries.name: Threading (manufacturing)
entries.definition: Cutting or forming helical screw threads on a part, for example by tapping, die cutting or turning on a lathe.

entries.name: Threat modeling
entries.definition: A structured way of identifying what could attack a system, how, and which defences are needed, usually done while designing it.

entries.name: Three.js
entries.definition: A JavaScript library for creating and displaying 3D graphics in a web browser, built on WebGL.

entries.name: Thyroid biopsy
entries.definition: Taking a sample of thyroid tissue, usually with a fine needle, so that it can be examined for disease.

entries.name: Thyroid cancer
entries.definition: A cancer that starts in the cells of the thyroid gland, with papillary, follicular, medullary and anaplastic types.

entries.name: Thyroid diseases and disorders
entries.definition: The conditions that affect the thyroid gland, such as underactive or overactive thyroid, goitre, nodules and thyroid cancer.

entries.name: Thyroid ultrasound
entries.definition: Using ultrasound imaging to examine the thyroid gland and look for nodules or other abnormalities.

entries.name: TIBCO ActiveMatrix
entries.definition: A TIBCO platform for building, deploying and managing service-oriented and composite applications.

entries.name: TIBCO Designer
entries.definition: A graphical tool from TIBCO for designing and configuring integration projects that run on TIBCO BusinessWorks.

entries.name: TIBCO Enterprise Message Service
entries.definition: A messaging server from TIBCO that implements the Java Message Service (JMS) standard for exchanging messages between applications.

entries.name: TIBCO iProcess Suite
entries.definition: A TIBCO business-process-management suite for modelling, automating and monitoring workflows that involve both people and systems.

entries.name: TIBCO Spotfire
entries.definition: A data visualization and analytics platform for exploring data and building interactive dashboards, originally from TIBCO.

entries.name: Time Protocol
entries.definition: A simple Internet protocol, specified in RFC 868, in which a server returns the current time as a 32-bit count of seconds since 1 January 1900.

entries.name: TinyDB
entries.definition: A small document-oriented database written in pure Python that by default stores its data in a JSON file.

entries.name: Tire balancing and rotation
entries.definition: Balancing wheel-and-tire assemblies so they spin evenly, and moving tires between wheel positions on a vehicle to even out wear.

entries.name: TL 9000
entries.definition: A quality management system standard for the telecommunications industry, built on ISO 9001.

entries.name: TOGAF
entries.definition: An enterprise architecture framework from The Open Group that gives a method and set of tools for designing, planning and governing an organisation's information systems.

entries.name: TokuDB
entries.definition: A storage engine for MySQL and MariaDB that used fractal tree indexes to speed up writes and compress data.

entries.name: Agent tool use
entries.definition: Connecting an agent to bounded external capabilities.

entries.name: Toon Boom
entries.definition: A family of 2D animation and storyboarding software, including Harmony and Storyboard Pro, made by Toon Boom Animation.

entries.name: TopSolid
entries.definition: A CAD/CAM software suite for designing and machining parts, made by Missler Software.

entries.name: Torch (machine learning)
entries.definition: An open-source scientific computing and machine learning library with a C core and a Lua interface, which came before PyTorch.

entries.name: Tourism management
entries.definition: Planning, running and promoting tourism services and destinations, such as attractions, accommodation and tours.

entries.name: Trace (linear algebra)
entries.definition: The sum of the entries on the main diagonal of a square matrix.

entries.name: Track and trace
entries.definition: Following the current position of a product or shipment (tracking) and recording the path it took through the supply chain (tracing).

entries.name: TrackWise
entries.definition: Enterprise quality management software used in regulated industries such as pharmaceuticals to manage complaints, deviations and corrective and preventive actions.

entries.name: Traffic Alert and Collision Avoidance System
entries.definition: An aircraft system that uses transponder signals to detect nearby aircraft and advises pilots how to avoid a collision.

entries.name: Traffic collision reconstruction
entries.definition: Working out how a vehicle collision happened, such as speeds and paths, by analysing physical evidence, vehicle damage and physics.

entries.name: Training and development needs assessment
entries.definition: Finding the gaps between the knowledge and skills people have and those their work requires, so that training can be planned.

entries.name: Training material development
entries.definition: Creating the guides, slides, exercises and other content used to teach people a job or a product.

entries.name: Trans-Proteomic Pipeline
entries.definition: An open-source software suite for processing and validating mass spectrometry proteomics data, from peptide identification to protein quantification.

entries.name: Transaction monitoring
entries.definition: Reviewing customer account activity, often with automated alerts, to detect suspicious transactions such as money laundering or fraud.

entries.name: Transient expression
entries.definition: Temporarily producing a protein from a gene introduced into cells, without the gene becoming a permanent part of the cell's genome.

entries.name: Trauma-focused cognitive behavioral therapy
entries.definition: A short-term psychotherapy for children and adolescents affected by trauma, combining cognitive behavioural techniques with work involving their caregivers.
